p0Failures.description: Project policy: no P0-priority test may fail in the evidence considered for the active profile.

criticalPathPassRate.description: Project policy: every executed critical-path test (application launch, catalog/product/cart, checkout) must pass.

functionalPassRate.description: Project policy threshold, not an industry standard: the functional suite must pass at 95% or higher.

crashCount.description: Project policy: any Monkey- or soak-detected crash blocks release when stability evidence exists.

anrCount.description: Project policy: any detected Application Not Responding condition blocks release when stability evidence exists.

flakyRate.description: Project policy: a stability-repeat flaky rate above 2% is a warning, not a block, until it recurs across releases.

securityCritical.description: Project policy: any CRITICAL security finding (exploitable secret, manifest exposure, dependency) blocks release.

securityHighDependency.description: Project policy: up to 3 HIGH-severity third-party dependency vulnerabilities are a warning, since they are typically dev-time or transitive and not directly exploitable in the shipped app.

securityHighProduct.description: Project policy: any HIGH-severity finding against the product itself (source-tree secret, manifest/component exposure) blocks release; it is not covered by the relaxed dependency limit above.

accessibilityCritical.description: Project policy: any confirmed accessibility defect (status 'confirmed', not a testability-issue) blocks release when accessibility evidence exists.

visualRegressionFailures.description: Project policy: unapproved visual regressions are a warning by default; the release profile escalates this gate to blocking.

installationCriticalPassRate.description: Project policy: clean install/uninstall must fully pass when installation evidence exists.

compatibilityMandatoryProfiles.description: Project policy: the mandatory compatibility profiles configured for the active policy profile must have executed and passed their critical path.

performanceRegression.description: Project policy: functional timings must not regress more than 20% against a trusted baseline; NOT_EVALUATED when no baseline is configured, per the project's rule against gating on arbitrary absolute values.
